<div class="card-body">
'''Takeel''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タキール</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦闘で、双方のプレイヤーが運命数を１つずつ引いた時に使う。１フォース消費してその値を取り替えることができる。</span><ref name="jp1-face" /><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Takeel-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Takeel (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Takeel-SWCCGcards.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
<span lang="ja">タキールは落ち目のスニヴィアン傭兵であり、裏切り者としても知られる。スパイス中毒者で、カンティーナで仕事をあさっている。犯罪者を帝国軍に売り渡すこともある。</span><ref name="jp1-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Takeel.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Card text:''' Use when both players have each drawn one destiny during a battle. You may use 1 Force to exchange those values.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Lore:''' Takeel is a down-on-his-luck Snivvian mercenary, also known as a traitor. Addicted to spice, he hunts for work in the Cantina. He sometimes sells criminals out to the Empire.<ref name="jp1-face" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes each player drawing one destiny during a battle; the English specifically says one battle destiny. The Japanese lore calls Takeel down-on-his-luck and a traitor, while the English calls him burned-out and a double-crosser.<ref name="jp1-face" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-D-takeel.gif|Takeel original English printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Takeel]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
